rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete template for the child. Both are personal letters accepting a Cabinet secretary's resignation, and they follow the same distinctive sequence: acknowledge that the resignation confirms repeated prior conversations; accept it reluctantly on the requested effective date; review the secretary's departmental or national service; anticipate continued advice or support; express gratitude and appreciation; and close with good wishes. Several close verbal correspondences make the relationship materially stronger than shared genre alone. C12 and C04 are also structurally similar Cabinet-resignation letters, but they lack C03's dense combination of shared language and sequencing.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Your letter of November tenth confirms the wish you had often expressed in our previous talks and leaves me no alternative.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Your letter received this day confirms our many previous conversations and discussions. I am therefore fully cognizant of the considerations which prompt your desire to relinquish your duties
shared_material.explanation: Both open by treating the resignation letter as confirmation of a desire repeatedly discussed in prior conversations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I therefore accept reluctantly and with sincere regret your resignation as the Secretary of the Interior, effective as you desire, as of December first next.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I accept your resignation effective at the close of business on March thirty-first. Although I take this action reluctantly
shared_material.explanation: Both combine reluctant acceptance, the Cabinet office, and a specifically stated effective date.

shared_material.child_excerpt: it is reassuring to know, as you leave the Department, that we will have your continued support
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I do so with less misgiving because I know you will be standing by to give advice and counsel as we go forward
shared_material.explanation: Both soften the departure by anticipating the resigning secretary's continued assistance.

shared_material.child_excerpt: For all that you have done ... you have my hearty gratitude and appreciation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: For all that you have done in your country's behalf ... I tender you heartfelt assurance of my gratitude and appreciation.
shared_material.explanation: This is a close and distinctive gratitude formula appearing in the same late-letter position.

shared_material.child_excerpt: With every good wish for your continued happiness and success
shared_material.explanation: Both close the resignation letter with the same good-wishes formula.
